{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose a login prompt reachable at telnet 127.0.0.1 6665; block until readiness is verified.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process using /app/alpine.iso","A launch log or receipt showing the exact QEMU invocation and background start","A probe receipt showing 127.0.0.1:6665 returns an Alpine login prompt"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU must remain running in the background after setup","Host port 6665 must forward to the guest login service","A telnet connection to 127.0.0.1 6665 must display a login prompt before finalization"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only confirming the ISO file exists","Only confirming QEMU can start without verifying the login prompt","Leaving QEMU in the foreground","Port open without a login prompt","Using a different host port than 6665"],"verification_plan":["Inspect workspace for any helper scripts or prior receipts","Launch QEMU detached/backgrounded with hostfwd to port 6665 and capture a receipt","Probe 127.0.0.1 6665 until the login prompt is observed and capture a receipt"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Launch receipt with command and process/background evidence","Probe receipt showing the login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665"],"notes":["Preserve the original objective if derived state conflicts with it.","Use receipt-backed evidence only; do not finalize on file existence or non-semantic smoke checks."]},{"type":"working_checklist","items":["Inspect visible files and any prior receipts for launch details","Determine the correct QEMU invocation for /app/alpine.iso","Start QEMU in the background with hostfwd to 127.0.0.1:6665","Probe the telnet endpoint until the login prompt appears","Keep the VM running after verification"]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"cd /app && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort","timeout":120000}]}
